subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress change from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` as the opt-in?
rationale: The diff fixes a real inbound-delivery failure but changes upgrade behavior and operator egress-control expectations, which automation cannot safely decide as a code-only question.
